# Rachel

> Open-source, vendor-neutral reference implementation of a grounded AI
> research analyst for retail and consumer intelligence. MIT licensed.

Rachel scores companies on two axes derived only from public investor
documents: board AI rhetoric (1-5) and confirmed production AI use cases
(0-5+). Every field carries a source URL and an evidence tier (confirmed or
estimated). The scoring methodology is public and reproducible; see
METHODOLOGY.md in the repository.

## What this site contains

- Quadrant classifications (performer, narrative_led, silent_builder,
  not_visible, native) produced by the published rubric, frozen as a
  point-in-time snapshot with sources on every claim
- Vendor footprint data as disclosed in filings, case studies, and press
- A demo mode (/app?demo=1) with an entirely fictional dataset

## Corrections

Company representatives: if a field is wrong or outdated, open an issue on
the repository with a source. See CORRECTIONS.md.

https://github.com/juliedemoyer/rachel-retail-analyst
